<style>
  :root{
    --red:        #E1333A;
    --red-deep:   #AF0000;
    --cyan:       #0CC0DF;
    --navy:       #1B2C47;
    --navy-deep:  #0E1A2E;
    --cream:      #FAF7F2;
    --paper:      #FFFFFF;

    --f-display: "Asap Condensed", sans-serif;
    --f-body:    "Urbanist", sans-serif;

    --ease-out: cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
  }

  *,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
  img{max-width:100%;display:block}
  a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}

  /* ---------- ENTRANCE SYSTEM ---------- */
  .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .9s var(--ease-out), transform .9s var(--ease-out)}
  .reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
  .reveal-l{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-32px);transition:opacity .9s var(--ease-out), transform .9s var(--ease-out)}
  .reveal-l.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
  .reveal-r{opacity:0;transform:translateX(32px);transition:opacity .9s var(--ease-out), transform .9s var(--ease-out)}
  .reveal-r.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
  .reveal-scale{opacity:0;transform:scale(.94);transition:opacity 1s var(--ease-out), transform 1s var(--ease-out)}
  .reveal-scale.in{opacity:1;transform:none}

  /* ---------- TOP BAR ---------- */
  .topbar{
    background:var(--navy-deep);
    color:#fff;
    font-family:var(--f-display);
    font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:.04em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    font-size:13px;
    padding:10px 24px;
    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:28px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    border-bottom:2px solid var(--red);
  }
  .topbar span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
  .topbar .dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--cyan); animation:pulse 1.8s infinite}
  @keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.35}}

  .brand{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
  }
  .brand-mark{
    width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:10px;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--red) 0%, var(--red-deep) 100%);
    display:grid;place-items:center;
    box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(225,51,58,.35);
    transform:rotate(-3deg);
  }
  .brand-mark svg{width:24px;height:24px;color:#fff}
  .brand-name{
    font-family:var(--f-display);
    font-weight:800;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:.02em;
    line-height:.95;
    font-size:20px;
    color:var(--navy);
  }
  .brand-name small{display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;color:var(--red);font-weight:700;margin-top:2px}
  .cta-call{
    font-family:var(--f-display);
    text-transform:uppercase;
    font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:.04em;
    font-size:14px;
    background:var(--navy);
    color:#fff;
    padding:11px 20px;
    border-radius:999px;
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
    transition:transform .25s var(--ease-out), background .25s;
  }
  .cta-call:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:var(--red)}

  /* ---------- HERO ---------- */
  .hero{
    position:relative;
    padding:40px 32px 80px;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .hero-bg{
    position:absolute;inset:0;
    pointer-events:none;
    z-index:0;
  }
  .hero-bg::before{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    top:-180px;right:-180px;
    width:520px;height:520px;border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(12,192,223,.28) 0%, rgba(12,192,223,0) 70%);
    filter:blur(10px);
    animation:float1 12s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .hero-bg::after{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    bottom:-220px;left:-160px;
    width:560px;height:560px;border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(225,51,58,.18) 0%, rgba(225,51,58,0) 70%);
    filter:blur(10px);
    animation:float2 14s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes float1{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}50%{transform:translate(-30px,40px)}}
  @keyframes float2{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}50%{transform:translate(40px,-30px)}}

  .grid-overlay{
    position:absolute;inset:0;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(rgba(27,44,71,.04) 1px,transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(27,44,71,.04) 1px,transparent 1px);
    background-size:48px 48px;
    mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at center, black 30%, transparent 75%);
    -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at center, black 30%, transparent 75%);
    z-index:0;
  }

  .hero-inner{
    max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;
    display:grid;grid-template-columns: 1.05fr .95fr;
    gap:56px;align-items:center;
    position:relative;z-index:1;
  }

  .eyebrow{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
    font-family:var(--f-display);
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:.18em;
    font-size:13px;
    font-weight:700;
    color:var(--red);
    background:rgba(225,51,58,.08);
    padding:8px 14px;
    border-radius:999px;
    border:1px solid rgba(225,51,58,.2);
  }
  .eyebrow .pulse{
    width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);
    box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(225,51,58,.6);
    animation:pulseRing 2s infinite;
  }
  @keyframes pulseRing{
    0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(225,51,58,.6)}
    70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 12px rgba(225,51,58,0)}
    100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(225,51,58,0)}
  }

  h1.headline{
    font-family:var(--f-display);
    font-weight:900;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    line-height:.92;
    letter-spacing:-.01em;
    font-size:clamp(44px, 6.4vw, 96px);
    margin:18px 0 18px;
    color:var(--navy);
  }
  h1.headline .save{
    color:var(--red);
    display:inline-block;
    position:relative;
  }
  h1.headline .save::after{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    left:-2%;right:-2%;bottom:6px;
    height:14px;
    background:rgba(12,192,223,.35);
    z-index:-1;
    transform:skew(-8deg);
  }
  h1.headline .new{
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, var(--navy) 0%, var(--navy-deep) 100%);
    -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
  }
  h1.headline em{
    font-style:italic;
    font-weight:700;
    color:var(--cyan);
    font-family:var(--f-display);
  }

  .sub{
    font-size:18px;
    line-height:1.55;
    color:#3b4a63;
    max-width:540px;
    margin:0 0 28px;
    font-weight:400;
  }
  .sub strong{color:var(--navy);font-weight:700}

  .perks{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
    gap:14px;
    margin-bottom:32px;
  }
  .perk{
    background:#fff;
    border:1.5px solid rgba(27,44,71,.08);
    border-radius:14px;
    padding:14px 14px;
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
    box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(27,44,71,.04);
    transition:transform .3s var(--ease-out), box-shadow .3s, border-color .3s;
  }
  .perk:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(27,44,71,.08);border-color:rgba(12,192,223,.4)}
  .perk-icon{
    width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;
    display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 auto;
  }
  .perk-icon svg{width:20px;height:20px}
  .perk:nth-child(1) .perk-icon{background:rgba(225,51,58,.1);color:var(--red)}
  .perk:nth-child(2) .perk-icon{background:rgba(12,192,223,.15);color:var(--cyan)}
  .perk:nth-child(3) .perk-icon{background:rgba(27,44,71,.08);color:var(--navy)}
  .perk-text{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:13px;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:.02em}
  .perk-text small{display:block;font-family:var(--f-body);font-weight:500;font-size:11px;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;color:#64748b;margin-top:2px}

  .scroll-cue{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
    font-family:var(--f-display);
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:.18em;
    font-size:12px;
    font-weight:700;
    color:var(--navy);
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .scroll-cue .arrow{
    width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--red);color:#fff;
    display:grid;place-items:center;
    box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(225,51,58,.35);
    animation:bob 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(6px)}}

  /* ---------- HERO ART (right column) ---------- */
  .hero-art{
    position:relative;
    width:100%;
    max-width:560px;
    aspect-ratio: 5/6;
    justify-self:end;
  }
  .photo-card{
    position:absolute;
    border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;
    box-shadow:0 30px 60px -20px rgba(27,44,71,.35), 0 12px 24px rgba(27,44,71,.18);
    background:#0e1a2e;
  }
  .photo-card img{width:100%;height:100% !important;object-fit:cover}
  .photo-main{
    inset:0;
    border:6px solid #fff;
    transform:translate(var(--px,0), var(--py,0)) rotate(2deg);
  }
  .photo-secondary{
    width:54%;aspect-ratio:1/1;
    bottom:-30px;left:-32px;
    border:5px solid #fff;
    transform:rotate(-5deg);
    z-index:2;
  }
  .photo-main, .photo-secondary{transition:transform .7s var(--ease-out)}
  .hero-art:hover .photo-main{transform:rotate(0deg)}
  .hero-art:hover .photo-secondary{transform:rotate(-2deg) translateY(-6px)}

  /* Badge — now shows FREE / Thermostat */
  .badge-500{
    position:absolute;
    top:-22px;right:-22px;
    width:148px;height:148px;border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--red);
    color:#fff;
    display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;
    box-shadow:0 18px 36px rgba(175,0,0,.4), inset 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,.18);
    z-index:3;
    animation:spinBadge 22s linear infinite;
  }
  @keyframes spinBadge{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
  .badge-500-inner{
    animation:spinBadge 22s linear infinite reverse;
    padding:6px;
  }
  .badge-500 .save{
    font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;
    font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.18em;display:block;margin-bottom:2px;opacity:.85;
  }
  .badge-500 .amt{
    font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:900;
    font-size:38px;line-height:1;display:block;
  }
  .badge-500 .off{
    font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;
    font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;display:block;margin-top:2px;
  }

  .stick-tag{
    position:absolute;
    bottom:50px;right:-28px;
    background:var(--cyan);
    color:#0E1A2E;
    padding:14px 18px;border-radius:14px;
    box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(12,192,223,.4);
    font-family:var(--f-display);
    text-transform:uppercase;
    font-weight:800;
    line-height:1;
    z-index:3;
    transform:rotate(4deg);
    transition:transform .4s var(--ease-out);
  }
  .stick-tag:hover{transform:rotate(0)}
  .stick-tag .num{font-size:28px;display:block}
  .stick-tag .lbl{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.18em;font-weight:700;margin-top:4px;display:block}

  /* ---------- WARRANTY STRIP ---------- */
  .warranty-strip{
    background:var(--navy);
    color:#fff;
    overflow:hidden;
    position:relative;
    padding:24px 0;
    border-top:3px solid var(--red);
    border-bottom:3px solid var(--red);
  }
  .marquee{
    display:flex;gap:48px;
    animation:scroll 30s linear infinite;
    white-space:nowrap;
    width:max-content;
  }
  .marquee span{
    font-family:var(--f-display);
    text-transform:uppercase;
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:32px;
    letter-spacing:.04em;
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:48px;
  }
  .marquee span::after{
    content:"";width:14px;height:14px;
    background:var(--cyan);transform:rotate(45deg);
  }
  .marquee em{color:var(--red);font-style:normal}
  @keyframes scroll{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

  /* ---------- OFFER DETAILS ---------- */
  .offer-section{
    padding:100px 32px 80px;
    position:relative;
  }
  .offer-inner{
    max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:64px;align-items:start;
  }
  .section-tag{
    font-family:var(--f-display);
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--red);
    letter-spacing:.22em;
    font-weight:700;
    font-size:13px;
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
    margin-bottom:18px;
  }
  .section-tag::before{content:"";width:32px;height:2px;background:var(--red)}
  h2.section-h{
    font-family:var(--f-display);
    text-transform:uppercase;
    font-weight:900;
    font-size:clamp(36px,4.5vw,60px);
    line-height:.95;
    letter-spacing:-.005em;
    color:var(--navy);
    margin:0 0 22px;
  }
  h2.section-h em{color:var(--cyan);font-style:italic;font-weight:700}

  .lead{font-size:18px;line-height:1.6;color:#3b4a63;margin:0 0 28px;max-width:520px}

  .covers{
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-bottom:28px;
  }
  .cover{
    background:#fff;
    border-radius:16px;
    padding:22px 18px;
    border:1.5px solid rgba(27,44,71,.08);
    text-align:left;
    box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(27,44,71,.04);
    position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    transition:transform .35s var(--ease-out), box-shadow .35s, border-color .35s;
  }
  .cover::before{
    content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:4px;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--red),var(--cyan));
    transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;
    transition:transform .5s var(--ease-out);
  }
  .cover:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(27,44,71,.1);border-color:transparent}
  .cover:hover::before{transform:scaleX(1)}
  .cover-icon{
    width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:12px;
    background:rgba(27,44,71,.06);
    color:var(--navy);
    display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .cover-icon svg{width:22px;height:22px}
  .cover h4{
    font-family:var(--f-display);
    text-transform:uppercase;
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:18px;
    margin:0 0 4px;
    color:var(--navy);
  }
  .cover p{margin:0;font-size:13px;color:#64748b;line-height:1.45}

  /* S-Series lifetime badge inside cover card */
  .lifetime-badge{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;
    margin-top:8px;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--navy),var(--navy-deep));
    color:#fff;
    font-family:var(--f-display);
    text-transform:uppercase;
    font-size:10px;
    font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:.14em;
    padding:4px 9px;
    border-radius:999px;
  }
  .lifetime-badge svg{width:11px;height:11px;color:var(--cyan)}

  .brands{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;
    background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:18px 22px;
    border:1.5px solid rgba(27,44,71,.08);
    margin-bottom:28px;
  }
  .brands .lbl{
    font-family:var(--f-display);text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;font-size:12px;color:#64748b;
    border-right:1.5px solid rgba(27,44,71,.1);padding-right:18px;
  }
  .brand-pill{
    font-family:var(--f-display);text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.04em;font-size:18px;
    padding:6px 14px;border-radius:8px;
  }
  .brand-pill.goodman{background:#1B2C47;color:#fff}
  .brand-pill.amana{background:#E1333A;color:#fff}

  .fineprint{font-size:12px;color:#94a3b8;line-height:1.5;max-width:480px}

  /* FORM CARD */
  .form-card{
    position:sticky;top:24px;
    background:#fff;
    border-radius:24px;
    box-shadow:
      0 30px 60px -20px rgba(27,44,71,.25),
      0 10px 20px rgba(27,44,71,.08);
    overflow:hidden;
    border:1px solid rgba(27,44,71,.06);
  }
  .form-head{
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy) 0%, var(--navy-deep) 100%);
    color:#fff;
    padding:20px 22px 18px;
    position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  }
  .form-head::before{
    content:"";position:absolute;
    width:200px;height:200px;border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(12,192,223,.4) 0%, transparent 70%);
    top:-80px;right:-60px;
  }
  .form-head .tag{
    font-family:var(--f-display);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.18em;font-size:11px;color:var(--cyan);
    font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;display:block;
  }
  .form-head h3{
    font-family:var(--f-display);text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:900;font-size:28px;line-height:1;margin:0;
  }
  .form-head p{margin:8px 0 0;font-size:13px;opacity:.85;max-width:300px}
  .form-body{padding:18px 18px 18px}
  .form-body iframe{width:100%;border:none;border-radius:8px;min-height:294px;display:block;height:432px}

  .trust-row{
    display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:14px 22px;
    background:#F2F5FA;border-top:1px solid rgba(27,44,71,.06);
    font-family:var(--f-display);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);
    text-align:center;
  }
  .trust-row div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;flex:1}
  .trust-row svg{width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--red)}

  /* ---------- HOW IT WORKS ---------- */
  .steps-section{
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 0%, #F2F5FA 100%);
    padding:90px 32px;
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .steps-inner{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;text-align:center}
  .steps-grid{
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:48px;
    position:relative;
  }
  .steps-grid::before{
    content:"";position:absolute;top:38px;left:8%;right:8%;
    height:2px;
    background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cyan) 0 6px,transparent 6px 14px);
    z-index:0;
  }
  .step{
    background:#fff;
    padding:24px 20px;border-radius:18px;
    border:1.5px solid rgba(27,44,71,.08);
    position:relative;z-index:1;
    text-align:left;
    transition:transform .35s var(--ease-out), box-shadow .35s;
  }
  .step:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 18px 36px rgba(27,44,71,.1)}
  .step-num{
    font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:900;
    font-size:46px;line-height:1;
    color:var(--red);
    margin-bottom:12px;
    display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:6px;
  }
  .step-num::after{
    content:"";width:8px;height:8px;background:var(--cyan);border-radius:50%;
  }
  .step h4{
    font-family:var(--f-display);text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800;
    font-size:18px;color:var(--navy);margin:0 0 6px;
  }
  .step p{margin:0;font-size:13px;color:#64748b;line-height:1.5}

  /* ---------- FINAL CTA ---------- */
  .final-cta{
    background:var(--navy-deep);
    color:#fff;
    padding:80px 32px;
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .final-cta::before{
    content:"";position:absolute;
    width:700px;height:700px;border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(12,192,223,.18) 0%, transparent 70%);
    top:-300px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  }
  .final-cta::after{
    content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.03) 1px,transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.03) 1px,transparent 1px);
    background-size:48px 48px;
    mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,black 30%,transparent 75%);
    -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,black 30%,transparent 75%);
  }
  .final-inner{max-width:780px;margin:0 auto;position:relative;z-index:1}
  .final-cta h2{
    font-family:var(--f-display);text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:900;
    font-size:clamp(40px,6vw,84px);line-height:.95;letter-spacing:-.005em;
    margin:18px 0;
  }
  .final-cta h2 em{color:var(--cyan);font-style:italic;font-weight:700}
  .final-cta h2 .strike{color:var(--red);position:relative;display:inline-block}
  .final-cta p{font-size:18px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);max-width:560px;margin:0 auto 32px;line-height:1.55}
  .cta-buttons{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .btn{

<script>
  // Intersection Observer for entrance animations
  const els = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal,.reveal-l,.reveal-r,.reveal-scale');
  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
    entries.forEach(e=>{
      if(e.isIntersecting){
        e.target.classList.add('in');
        io.unobserve(e.target);
      }
    });
  },{threshold:.12, rootMargin:'0px 0px -40px 0px'});
  els.forEach(el=>io.observe(el));

  // Trigger above-the-fold reveals immediately on load
  window.addEventListener('load',()=>{
    document.querySelectorAll('.hero .reveal, .hero .reveal-l, .hero .reveal-r, .hero .reveal-scale, header .reveal-l, header .reveal-r')
      .forEach(el=>el.classList.add('in'));
  });

  // Subtle parallax on hero photos
  const art = document.querySelector('.hero-art');
  if(art && window.matchMedia('(min-width:980px)').matches){
    document.addEventListener('mousemove',(ev)=>{
      const r = art.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = (ev.clientX - (r.left + r.width/2)) / r.width;
      const y = (ev.clientY - (r.top + r.height/2)) / r.height;
      art.style.setProperty('--px', (x*-6) + 'px');
      art.style.setProperty('--py', (y*-6) + 'px');
    });
  }
</script>
